disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price, with a divergence z-score of 2.298 and fused acceleration of 3.817 across four sources [P2][P3]. However, the signal is heavily concentrated in lobbying (z=3.5): regulatory and 8-K activity are only modestly positive, while congressional net buying is negative [P3]. The theme is still forming, price has underperformed the market over 60 days, and there is no supporting news leg, so persistence and market confirmation remain unproven [P1][P4][P5]. Monitor rather than enter until the activity broadens or price begins to confirm.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动明显领先价格，活动与价格的背离值为2.298，四类来源的综合加速度为3.817 [P2][P3]。但信号主要由游说活动的强劲上升推动；监管进展和8-K重大事项仅小幅为正，国会议员净买入信号则为负 [P3]。主题仍处于形成阶段，过去60天价格跑输大盘，且没有新闻推动，因此持续性和价格确认尚未建立 [P1][P4][P5]。当前更适合观察，等待活动扩散或价格转强。
assessments.rationale_plain: Industry engagement with policymakers is rising sharply, while regulatory filings and corporate disclosures are improving only slightly and congressional trading is weak. Prices have lagged the broader market over the past 60 days, so the increased activity has not yet translated into investor demand. Keep watching for wider real-world momentum or a sustained price recovery before committing capital.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 行业与政策制定者的互动正在明显增加，但监管进展和企业重大事项披露仅小幅改善，国会议员交易活动仍然偏弱。相关资产过去60天跑输大盘，说明现实活动的升温尚未转化为投资者需求。现阶段宜继续观察，等待更多领域同步走强或价格持续回升后再考虑投入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish case is that activity is substantially ahead of price and accelerating across four measured sources, while weak 60-day relative performance may leave room for catch-up if the early signal persists [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the thesis if subsequent readings show continued positive activity across several sources—not only lobbying—and the covered members begin sustaining relative gains versus the market [P3][P4][P6].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if lobbying momentum fades without stronger regulatory or corporate-event activity, or if relative performance remains negative while the theme fails to progress beyond its forming stage [P1][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Memory, HBM & Storage

assessments.rationale: The current activity signal is strong but narrow: fused acceleration is 6.501 across three sources, driven overwhelmingly by a 3.5 lobbying-ramp z-score, while congressional buying is nearly neutral at 0.039 and material 8-K events are slightly negative at -0.101 [P3]. Persistence is uncertain because the setup is still forming and has no supporting news leg [P1][P5]. Activity leads price by 1.709 standard deviations, but 60-day relative strength remains negative at -7.9%, so price has not confirmed the signal [P2][P4]. This is an early divergence worth monitoring, not yet a sufficiently broad and persistent case to enter.
assessments.rationale_zh: 当前活动信号较强但集中：三个来源的综合加速度为6.501，主要由游说活动的3.5标准分推动；国会议员净买入仅为0.039，重大8-K事件则为-0.101 [P3]。持续性仍不明确，因为信号尚处形成阶段，且没有新闻支持 [P1][P5]。活动领先价格1.709个标准差，但过去60天相对市场仍落后7.9%，价格尚未确认 [P2][P4]。因此应继续观察，而非立即入场。
assessments.rationale_plain: Real-estate lobbying activity has jumped sharply, but congressional buying is nearly flat and corporate event filings are slightly weaker. Share prices have not followed—the group has trailed the market by about 8% over the past 60 days—and there is no supporting news momentum. The signal is promising but too concentrated and early to justify buying, so keep it on the watchlist.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 房地产相关游说活动明显升温，但国会议员买入几乎没有变化，企业重大事项披露也略有走弱。相关股票尚未跟上，过去60天落后大盘约8%，同时没有新闻热度提供支持。这个迹象值得关注，但目前过于集中且仍处早期，宜观察而非立即买入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that the three-source fused acceleration is exceptionally high at 6.501 and activity is already 1.709 standard deviations ahead of price; the current price weakness could therefore represent an entry window before recognition [P2][P3].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the thesis if the next observation shows congressional buying and/or material 8-K activity turning meaningfully positive alongside continued lobbying strength, while 60-day relative performance improves from the current -7.9% baseline [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the thesis if lobbying acceleration retreats materially without congressional or 8-K participation, or if relative performance deteriorates further while the activity-price divergence closes through weakening activity rather than rising price [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Real Estate (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Real activity is ahead of price, with a divergence z-score of 1.228 and an emerging positive-divergence setup [P1][P2]. The signal spans seven sources and is accelerating, led by unusually strong congressional net buying, alongside positive federal contracting, pre-award solicitations, and news flow [P3]. Durability is only moderate because lobbying is flat, grant activity is weak, and material 8-K events are sharply negative [P3]. Price has not confirmed: 60-day relative strength versus SPY is negative, creating an entry opportunity if the activity persists rather than proof that the market has accepted the narrative [P4]. Fast-accelerating, entirely unscheduled news supports freshness but also raises event-driven reversal risk [P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动领先于价格，背离值为1.228，主题处于早期的正向背离阶段[P1][P2]。信号覆盖七类来源且整体加速，主要由国会议员净买入推动，联邦合同、招标前活动和新闻流也为正[P3]。但持续性仅属中等，因为游说活动基本持平、拨款机会信号较弱，而重大8-K事件明显为负[P3]。过去60天相对大盘表现为负，价格尚未确认，因此当前机会依赖现实活动继续增强[P4]；新闻全部来自非定期事件且正在快速加速，既显示新鲜度，也增加事件驱动反转风险[P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting, upcoming solicitations, congressional buying and news attention are picking up, while related share prices have lagged the broader market. That gap creates a potentially attractive early entry, but the case is not yet fully secure because grant activity is weak, lobbying is flat and companies are reporting fewer material events. A cautious position is reasonable, with further buying dependent on continued contract and solicitation momentum.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同、招标前活动、国会议员买入和新闻关注度正在上升，但相关公司的股价仍落后于大盘。这种落差提供了较早介入的机会，不过拨款活动偏弱、游说投入停滞，而且企业披露的重大事件减少，说明支撑尚不全面。可以谨慎建仓，但后续加仓应以合同和招标活动继续增强为前提。
assessments.dissent: The apparent acceleration may be driven disproportionately by congressional buying and news rather than improving company-level fundamentals: material 8-K events are strongly negative, lobbying is flat, grants are barely positive, and price continues to underperform [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Over the next measurement window, federal-contract and pre-award-solicitation signals remain positive or strengthen, the fused acceleration stays positive, and relative performance begins improving from its current negative reading [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The thesis fails if federal-contract and solicitation signals turn negative, fused acceleration fades toward or below zero, or continued price underperformance is accompanied by persistently negative material-event activity [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price, with divergence z=1.223 and fused acceleration of 5.757 across four sources [P2][P3]. However, the signal is uneven: lobbying is exceptionally strong at z=3.5 and government contracts are positive at z=1.367, while congressional buying and material 8-K events are negative [P3]. The theme is still forming [P1], has no supporting news leg [P5], and covers only ADM and SYY [P6], limiting evidence that the impulse will persist broadly. Relative performance trails the market by 2.82% over 60 days [P4], so price has not confirmed the activity; monitor for broader persistence before entering.
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动明显领先价格：活动与价格的背离为1.223，四个来源的综合加速度达到5.757 [P2][P3]。但信号并不均衡，游说活动和政府合同较强，而国会净买入及重大8-K事件为负 [P3]。主题仍处于形成阶段 [P1]，没有新闻推动 [P5]，且仅覆盖ADM和SYY [P6]，持续性证据有限。过去60天相对大盘落后2.82% [P4]，价格尚未确认，因此应继续观察而非立即进入。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting and lobbying activity are picking up, but the improvement is uneven because corporate disclosures and congressional trading do not confirm it. The group has also lagged the market by roughly 2.8% over the past 60 days, with no supporting news momentum. With only two companies represented, the prudent course is to watch for broader, sustained activity and an improving price trend before buying.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同和游说活动正在升温，但企业重大披露和国会交易并未同步改善，因此信号并不均衡。相关公司过去60天落后大盘约2.8%，也没有新闻热度提供支持。由于目前只覆盖两家公司，更稳妥的做法是等待活动扩展并持续，同时观察价格走势是否转强。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case for entering now is that activity already leads price by a meaningful margin [P2], while exceptionally strong lobbying, positive government contracting, and high four-source fused acceleration could represent an early inflection before price catches up [P3]; the forming stage is consistent with such an early opportunity [P1].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade toward entry if subsequent readings show government contracts and lobbying remaining positive while congressional buying or material 8-K activity also turns positive, and 60-day relative performance improves from the current -2.82% baseline [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Avoid if lobbying and government-contract activity retreat toward or below neutral, fused acceleration falls materially from 5.757, or relative performance weakens further without a news leg emerging [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: The real-activity signal is meaningful but uneven: lobbying is exceptionally strong at z=3.5 and fused acceleration is 5.79 across three sources, while congressional net buying is neutral-to-negative and material 8-K events are weak [P3]. Durability is not yet established because the theme is only forming, the strongest contribution is concentrated in lobbying, and there is no supporting news leg [P1][P3][P5]. Price has not confirmed: 60-day relative performance is -3.59%, while activity leads price by a moderately positive divergence of 1.109 [P2][P4]. MONITOR is appropriate until the activity broadens beyond lobbying or relative performance begins to improve.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号有一定力度但并不均衡：游说活动非常强，三类来源的综合加速度也很高，但国会净买入略偏弱，重大8-K事件明显疲软 [P3]。持续性尚未得到证明，因为主题仍处于形成阶段，主要动力集中在游说活动，而且没有新闻支持 [P1][P3][P5]。价格也未确认这一变化：近60日相对大盘落后3.59%，而真实活动领先价格的背离为1.109 [P2][P4]。因此应继续观察，等待游说以外的活动增强，或相对表现开始改善。
assessments.rationale_plain: Defensive companies are seeing a sharp rise in lobbying activity, but corporate disclosures and congressional buying do not show the same momentum. Their shares have lagged the market by about 3.6% over the past 60 days, suggesting that investors have not yet embraced the theme. Watch for stronger activity across several channels or improving relative performance before committing capital.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 防御类公司的游说活动明显升温，但公司重大披露和国会买入并未呈现同样的势头。过去60天，这类股票相对大盘落后约3.6%，说明投资者尚未认可这一趋势。宜继续观察，等更多渠道同步增强或相对表现改善后再考虑投入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish case is that the 5.79 fused acceleration spans all three measured sources and activity already leads price by 1.109, so weak relative performance may represent an early entry window rather than a lack of confirmation [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the thesis if the next observation shows non-negative congressional buying and 8-K activity alongside continued strong lobbying, with 60-day relative strength turning positive [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the thesis if lobbying momentum falls materially while congressional buying and 8-K activity remain negative, especially if relative performance continues to deteriorate and no news support appears [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Defensives

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully positive but uneven: lobbying (2.888) and material 8-K events (2.762) are exceptionally strong, with accelerating news flow (2.067), while federal contracts (-0.669), grants/loans (-0.203), and pre-award solicitations (-0.48) remain weak [P3][P5]. Persistence is plausible because the signal spans nine sources, overall acceleration is 1.56, and all observed news is unscheduled, although dependence on two standout inputs limits conviction [P3][P5]. Price has not confirmed: 60-day relative performance is -10.76%, while activity leads price by 0.963, creating an emerging positive divergence and a potential entry window [P1][P2][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号明显但不均衡：游说活动（2.888）和重大8-K事件（2.762）非常强，新闻流也在加速（2.067），但联邦合同、拨款贷款和招标前需求仍偏弱 [P3][P5]。信号覆盖九个来源且整体加速度为1.56，全部新闻均为非预定发布，说明热度可能延续；不过，目前较依赖两个突出的来源，因此信心有限 [P3][P5]。价格尚未确认，近60日相对大盘落后10.76%，而现实活动领先价格0.963，形成早期正向背离和潜在入场窗口 [P1][P2][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Defense-related lobbying and major company disclosures have jumped, and news is arriving faster, but federal contracts, grants, and early procurement requests remain soft. Prices have lagged the market by about 11% over the past 60 days even as real-world activity improves. That gap supports a cautious entry, though the position should remain modest until procurement activity strengthens.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 国防相关游说活动和企业重大事项披露明显增加，相关新闻也在加速出现，但联邦合同、拨款和前期采购需求仍然偏弱。过去60天相关股票落后大盘约11%，尚未反映现实活动的改善。当前可以谨慎入场，但在采购活动真正转强前，仓位宜保持适中。
assessments.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that the apparent improvement is concentrated in lobbying and corporate disclosures rather than realized procurement: federal contracts, federal grants/loans, pre-award solicitations, and congressional buying are all negative, while price is also underperforming [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: The thesis is confirmed if lobbying and material-event activity remain elevated, news continues accelerating, and at least federal contracts or pre-award solicitations turn positive while relative price performance improves [P3][P4][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The thesis is disconfirmed if the lobbying and 8-K spikes fade without contracts or solicitations improving, news acceleration reverses, and relative performance remains negative [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Defense & Aerospace

rotation.summary: Leadership is broadening from fading megacap, energy and crypto trades toward equal-weight cyclicals/defensives and emerging hardware themes; real activity leads price in the positive-divergence cohort, while cybersecurity, AI software/agents, fintech, health care and precious-metal miners are already confirmed uptrends.
rotation.summary_zh: 领导力正从走弱的科技巨头、能源和加密交易转向等权周期/防御板块及新兴硬件主题；正向背离组由实体活动领先价格，而网络安全、AI软件/智能体、金融科技、医疗和贵金属矿业已获确认上行。
accumulate: Memory, HBM & Storage — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: activity leads price.
Real Estate (Equal-Weight) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: early broadening signal.
Space Economy and Defense & Aerospace — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, emerging: activity-led nascent leadership.
Consumer Staples and Defensives — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: defensive participation is building before price confirmation.
Consumer Discretionary and Retail — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: consumer activity leads market pricing.
Communication Services, Robotics & Automation, and Financials (Equal-Weight) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: prospective breadth leadership.
Cybersecurity, AI Software & Platforms, and AI Agents & Applications — CONFIRMED_UP, mature: real activity and price agree, though trends are advanced.
Payments & Fintech — CONFIRMED_UP, confirming: fresher activity-and-price confirmation.
Health Care (Equal-Weight), Gold Miners, and Silver Miners — CONFIRMED_UP, mature: established confirmed leadership.
reduce: Energy (Equal-Weight) and US Energy Complex — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price is running ahead of weakening activity.
Big Pharma — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: underlying activity no longer confirms price.
Crypto & Digital Rails — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price-led move lacks activity confirmation.
Magnificent Seven — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: concentrated leadership is losing real-activity support.
Nuclear & SMR Power, Utilities, and Power & Grid Buildout — CONFIRMED_DOWN, fading: both activity and price point lower.
Non-AI Tech & Hardware and Critical Minerals & Rare Earths — CONFIRMED_DOWN, fading: confirmed deterioration rather than mere price weakness.
watch: Positive-divergence themes upgrading to CONFIRMED_UP would validate the rotation, especially memory/storage, financials, retail, robotics, defense and space.
Failure of positive-divergence themes back to QUIET or NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE would invalidate the activity-led accumulation case.
Magnificent Seven, energy or crypto rails returning to CONFIRMED_UP would signal renewed old-leadership strength.
AI infrastructure, AI semiconductors and neoclouds leaving QUIET would show whether AI leadership is broadening beyond mature software and agents.
Confirmed-down power/grid, nuclear, utilities, critical minerals and non-AI hardware stabilizing to QUIET or turning positive would mark an investable reversal.
